issues.problem: toii example verdict 背が高い is a plain description, not the evaluative judgement といい requires (and that the guide itself teaches).
issues.action: Changed verdict to 礼儀正しい ('so polite') and updated the English.

issues.problem: nari-nari example English 'Study somewhere quiet, the library or at home' was awkward.
issues.action: Rewrote as 'Study somewhere quiet, such as the library or your own home.'

issues.problem: nari-nari mistake fix 雨やら風やら、ひどい一日だった reads unnaturally without the cause marker.
issues.action: Changed good sentence to 雨やら風やらで、ひどい一日だった。

issues.problem: Mistake 'bad' 貧しさがゆえに is not plainly wrong: noun + がゆえに (若さがゆえに, それがゆえに) is widely used; it is only less standard.
issues.action: Replaced with a real error: 若さゆえに過ち → 若さゆえの過ち (ゆえの before a noun); added a note in explain that noun + がゆえに occurs but ゆえに is standard.

issues.problem: Mistake 'bad' 正直がゆえに is borderline (正直 also works as a noun; 正直ゆえに is fine), so marking it wrong risks teaching a falsehood.
Register mistake used ないゆえに, mixing a form issue into a register lesson.
issues.action: Changed bad sentence to 時間がないがゆえに so only the register is wrong.

issues.problem: Explain described the idiom as 'Vばこそ meaning far from V'; the idiom is ～もあらばこそ meaning 'there was not even (time/room to)'. Also example English 'thanks to my friends, and only them' was awkward.
issues.action: Corrected idiom description with gloss; rewrote English as 'It is only because I had my friends that I made it this far.'

issues.problem: Proverb この親にしてこの子あり was filed under the 'both A and B' use, but it belongs to the 'only at that level' use; the 'even N' use (名人にしてこのミスだ) was missing.
issues.action: Moved the proverb to use 1 and added the 'even N' sense.
